hero.title: An integrated solution to manage and execute marketing services from one place.
hero.description:
Markeva is a digital platform that helps individuals and companies manage their marketing services easily and clearly.
From requesting the service, to follow-up, and up to receiving results — all done through a single dashboard, without complexity or unnecessary steps.

services.sectionDescription: A set of marketing services that you can manage and track easily through a single, methodical and clear dashboard.
services.card1Description: Organize and manage advertising campaigns through a clear workflow, including goal setting, execution tracking, and results review from one place.
services.card2Description: Manage all visual identity elements of your business, including core designs and visual outputs within a unified and organized framework.
services.card3Description: Organize content requests and track execution and review phases, ensuring message consistency and easy content management across different channels.
services.card4Description: Manage digital marketing activities within a clear plan, covering execution and follow-up without needing separate coordination between multiple parties.
services.card5Description: View performance reports and results of marketing services, helping make decisions based on clear data and continuous follow-up.
services.card6Description: Organize all service orders and related communication through a single clear path, facilitating follow-up on notes, inquiries, and updates without relying on external channels.
services.noServices: No services available at the moment

aboutUs.motiveTitle: The motive behind establishing the Markeva platform
aboutUs.motiveDescription: Markeva was established to address the complexity of managing marketing services resulting from multiple entities and platforms, by providing a centralized system that facilitates follow-up, organization, and decision-making in a single integrated experience.
aboutUs.sectionTitle: Integrated management of marketing services from one place
aboutUs.paragraph1: Many companies and project owners have faced difficulties in managing their marketing services due to the multiplicity of entities and platforms.
aboutUs.paragraph2: From here, Markeva came to be a central point that gathers all marketing services in one place, which facilitates management, reduces distraction, and saves time and effort.
aboutUs.methodologyTitle: Clear execution methodology and continuous follow-up
aboutUs.methodologyDescription: Markeva relies on an organized workflow that ensures clarity at each stage of executing marketing services, starting from order receipt and requirement definition, through the execution and review stage, up to final delivery, with continuous tracking of work status and progress achieved at every step.
aboutUs.controlTitle: Full control and transparency in every detail
aboutUs.controlDescription: Markeva is designed to give the client full control over their marketing services through a centralized dashboard, where they can track status, communicate with the specialist team, and view reports and results, ensuring complete transparency and a clear experience without the need for multiple follow-ups or disorganized communication.

serviceManagement.sectionTitle: How are services managed inside Markeefa?
serviceManagement.sectionDescription: Markeefa operates according to a clear methodology that ensures order organization, clarity of execution stages, and the availability of continuous follow-up on the status of each service from the moment of order to final delivery, without the need to deal with multiple platforms or entities.
serviceManagement.card1Description: Markeefa provides a single point to manage all marketing service requests, facilitating order tracking, data unification, and reducing distractions from multiple channels and parties.
serviceManagement.card2Description: The platform relies on a clear execution mechanism that allows tracking the status of each service, and knowing what is done and what is in progress, without the need for separate communication or disorganized follow-up.
serviceManagement.card3Title: Clear Vision and Transparency in Details
serviceManagement.card3Description: Markeefa gives clients a comprehensive view of all service details through a centralized dashboard, including status, deliverables, and reports, ensuring a clear experience built on transparency and easy access to information.

testimonials.sectionTitle: User Reviews and Their Experiences with the Platform
testimonials.sectionDescription: Real ratings from users who have used the platform in their daily work, showing the level of efficiency, ease of use, and its actual impact on organizing work and improving productivity.
testimonials.review1Text: A very practical tool, we used it with the team and it saved a lot of time.
testimonials.review2Text: The experience is comfortable and fast, I feel the work is organized and there is no confusion.
testimonials.review3Text: The platform made a huge difference for us in organizing work and follow-up, everything became clear and fast.
testimonials.review4Text: Easy to learn and fast to use, and that made a difference in our daily work.
testimonials.review5Text: A smart and simple platform, needs some small additions but the experience is excellent.
testimonials.review6Text: The thing I liked most is that all notes arrive clearly and without repetition.

hero.title: Markeefa... Smart management for everything related to marketing
hero.description:
We are a passionate team building digital solutions that help companies organize their marketing work easily.
We noticed that most teams suffer from scattered tools and unclear follow-up, so we decided to build a platform
that gathers all of this in a single simple and practical experience.

taskManagement.title: Task & Campaign Management
taskManagement.description: Markeefa helps you organize marketing tasks clearly, from the moment they're created until they're fully executed. You can assign tasks to team members, track progress at every stage, and ensure a smooth workflow, helping campaigns get done on time and with greater efficiency. With Markeefa, you can create marketing tasks, assign them to the right team, and follow their execution step by step within an organized workspace that makes collaboration easier and reduces chaos.

teamManagement.title: Team Management
teamManagement.description: Working within your digital team, you'll find that collaboration between employees becomes easier through a single management hub, with clear roles and responsibilities, performance tracking, and support to help the team complete tasks on time.

reportsPerformance.title: Performance Reports & Tasks
reportsPerformance.description: View detailed reports and interactive dashboards displaying key performance indicators clearly and understandably, including employee performance, task completion rates, order status, and campaign progress. These reports help you track workflow in real-time, analyze results, discover strengths and opportunities for improvement, enabling data-driven strategic decisions to enhance team efficiency and achieve best results.

orderManagement.title: Order & Subscription Management
orderManagement.description: Manage all customer orders and subscriptions through a single integrated platform, tracking each order lifecycle from creation to completion. You can manage recurring packages, view subscription details, monitor order status in real-time, and handle payments, invoicing, and financial transaction history easily. The platform also enables you to monitor workflow and centralize all order and subscription data to deliver the best customer experience.

whyMarkeefa.title: Why Markeefa?
whyMarkeefa.description: We believe that the success of any marketing team starts with a platform that helps them work clearly and efficiently. We designed Markeefa to combine ease of use, smart organization, and precise analytics, giving you an integrated experience to manage your business with confidence and achieve better results.

feature1.title: Smart Task Management
feature1.description: Create tasks, distribute them to team members, set priorities and deadlines, and track progress in real-time to ensure work is completed efficiently and on time.

feature2.title: Effective Team Collaboration
feature2.description: Organize your team, assign responsibilities, define roles and permissions, track employee performance, and enhance collaboration within a unified workspace.

feature3.title: Accurate Reports & Analytics
feature3.description: Get interactive reports and dashboards displaying performance indicators and results, helping you make strategic decisions based on precise data.

mission.description: To empower marketing teams to work with higher efficiency through a unified platform that combines management, collaboration, and working as a single team.
